data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 28.9m (2014: GBP 24.8m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 116.166m (2014). During 2015 there were favourable movements on prior year gross claims reserves of GBP 28.9m (a c.24.9% release of opening reserves). The report attributes this to favourable claims development; no specific prior-year catastrophe or named event is cited as driving the movement and the report does not break down the reserve movement by line of business.
raw_causal_phrases: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 28.9m (2014: GBP 24.8m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2014.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities - Claims outstanding) 2014 comparative column. Prior year development is explicitly stated as a gross figure (GBP 28.9m favourable) in the Technical Provisions note. No breakdown of prior year movement by line of business is provided.
